articles.title: Dewas Murder Shock: Youth Drowns Girlfriend in Water Drum, Surrenders
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has emerged from Dewas district, Madhya Pradesh, where a young man killed his girlfriend by drowning her in a drum filled with water and left her body in his rented house at Vaishali Avenue Colony.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has emerged from Dewas district, Madhya Pradesh, where a young man killed his girlfriend by drowning her in a drum filled with water and left her body in his rented house at Vaishali Avenue Colony.

On September 29, the victim, identified as Lakshita Chaudhary (19), left home saying she was going to college but never returned. Her family lodged a missing complaint, and during the probe it was revealed that she was in a relationship with Monu alias Manoj Chauhan (33).

Police said the accused initially tried to mislead the girl’s family, but on Wednesday afternoon he shockingly sent them a message confessing to the murder and revealing that the body was in his room.

When police broke into the house, they found Lakshita’s decomposed body wrapped in a bedsheet near a water drum. Disturbingly, she was still dressed in a Garba costume with her hands and legs tied.

Later in the evening, Monu Chauhan surrendered at the City Police Station. He reportedly told investigators that he loved Lakshita but killed her in anger after learning she was in contact with another person.

The body has been sent to Indore for post-mortem, while police have begun a detailed investigation into the case.

articles.title: Six of Family, Including Four Children, Found Dead in House Fire After Brutal Killings
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bahraich, UP – A gruesome incident has shaken Bahraich district after six bodies—including four children, a woman, and a man—were recovered from a house engulfed in flames in Teperaha village under Ramgaon police station limits. Four cattle were also killed.

body.html:
Bahraich, UP – A gruesome incident has shaken Bahraich district after six bodies—including four children, a woman, and a man—were recovered from a house engulfed in flames in Teperaha village under Ramgaon police station limits. Four cattle were also killed.

According to police, house owner Vijay Maurya, a vegetable vendor, allegedly killed two minor boys—Sunny Verma and Suraj Yadav—with a sharp weapon before locking himself, his wife Dheeraj Kumari, and daughters Priyanshi and Riyanshi in a room. He then set it ablaze using gas cylinders. All inside were burnt alive.

A third child escaped as he had been sent away moments earlier.

Disturbingly, vermilion was found at the scene, sparking suspicions of occult motives, though officials have not confirmed this. Locals claim Maurya had been mentally unstable, particularly after losing an infant son two months ago, and had been behaving erratically.

Senior police and district officials rushed to the site. Forensic teams are examining the house while postmortems are awaited. Police are probing possible triggers, including mental health issues, family disputes, and agricultural tensions.

Security has been tightened with PAC deployment amid widespread shock during the Navratri festival season.

articles.title: 75-Year-Old Dies Day After Marrying 35-Year-Old in Jaunpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Kuchhmuchh village, Jaunpur, 75-year-old Sangruram tragically passed away the morning after marrying 35-year-old Manbhavati. Widowed a year ago and living alone, Sangruram had hoped for companionship in his later years.

body.html:
In Kuchhmuchh village, Jaunpur, 75-year-old Sangruram tragically passed away the morning after marrying 35-year-old Manbhavati. Widowed a year ago and living alone, Sangruram had hoped for companionship in his later years.

Despite advice from relatives against remarriage, he registered the marriage in court on September 29 and performed traditional rituals at a local temple. Manbhavati said they spent much of the night talking, with Sangruram assuring her he would take care of the children while she managed the household.

By morning, Sangruram’s health suddenly deteriorated, and he was declared dead at a hospital. The unexpected death has sparked speculation in the village—some see it as natural, while others consider the circumstances suspicious. Relatives, including nephews from Delhi, have delayed funeral rites and demanded their presence before cremation. Questions remain about whether a police investigation or post-mortem will be conducted.

articles.title: Punjab Horror: Daughter-in-Law Beats Elderly Mother-in-Law, Viral Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gurdaspur, Punjab – A shocking video from Gurdaspur has gone viral, showing a woman brutally assaulting her elderly mother-in-law.

body.html:
Gurdaspur, Punjab – A shocking video from Gurdaspur has gone viral, showing a woman brutally assaulting her elderly mother-in-law. The accused, Harjeet Kaur, is seen pulling the victim, Gurbajan Kaur, by her hair, slapping her, and hurling abuses while her grandson, Charatveer Singh, pleads for his grandmother’s safety.

According to police, Gurbajan Kaur has filed a complaint alleging ongoing physical and mental harassment by her daughter-in-law, who has also reportedly pressured her to transfer property. Charatveer Singh told authorities that his mother often assaulted both his grandmother and father, particularly while intoxicated, and that he recorded the video after being threatened.

In the viral footage, Harjeet Kaur is seen dragging her mother-in-law, pushing her onto a sofa, and striking her with a steel glass before throwing her to the ground. Police have issued a warning to Harjeet Kaur, and the investigation is ongoing.

The video has sparked widespread anger on social media, with users condemning the act of violence against the elderly.

articles.title: : Traffic Constable Carries Injured Woman on Shoulder After Garba Night Accident, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jabalpur, MP – A late-night road accident during Navratri celebrations in Jabalpur has highlighted the courage of a traffic constable whose quick action likely saved a young woman’s life.

body.html:
Jabalpur, MP – A late-night road accident during Navratri celebrations in Jabalpur has highlighted the courage of a traffic constable whose quick action likely saved a young woman’s life.

The woman, returning home after playing Garba near Janaki Raman College, was hit by a vehicle and suffered severe leg injuries. Unable to walk and with no immediate help from bystanders, she lay on the road as the crowd looked on.

At that moment, Traffic Constable Jitendra Dubey rushed to the spot, lifted the injured woman onto his shoulders, and ran to a nearby private hospital. Heavy festive traffic meant waiting for an ambulance could have delayed treatment.

His swift decision ensured the woman received timely medical care. A video of Constable Dubey carrying her on his shoulders has since gone viral on social media, earning widespread praise.

Police officials later said traffic staff are trained and expected to stay alert, proactive, and self-motivated to assist citizens at all times, especially during festivals.

articles.title: Jodhpur Spa Raid: HIV-Positive Foreign Woman Among Arrested, High-Profile Clients Under Scanner
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jodhpur, Rajasthan – Police raids on two spa centres — Asian Sanga and Sky Step — in Shastri Nagar have exposed illegal activities, sparking a public health scare. During the raid, 15 people were arrested, including 8 women and 7 men.

body.html:
Jodhpur, Rajasthan – Police raids on two spa centres — Asian Sanga and Sky Step — in Shastri Nagar have exposed illegal activities, sparking a public health scare.

During the raid, 15 people were arrested, including 8 women and 7 men. Among them were 3 foreign nationals from Thailand and Kenya. Shockingly, one of the foreign women tested HIV positive.

Authorities are now urgently tracing her contacts, including clients and associates. Police sources revealed that the spas were frequented by prominent individuals, including outsiders and government officials, raising fears of wider exposure.

Investigations are underway into possible immigration violations, as C-forms of the foreign nationals were found incomplete. Police are also probing brokers and networks linked to the spas.

The revelation has triggered panic across the city, with health officials urging anyone who visited these parlours to undergo HIV testing and counselling.

The case is now being treated as both a law enforcement crackdown and a public health emergency, raising questions about the regulation of spa and massage centres in urban areas.

articles.title: Haridwar Hospital Negligence: Woman Forced to Deliver Baby on Floor After Denial of Admission
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case of shocking negligence has surfaced at Haridwar’s district women’s hospital, where a pregnant woman was forced to deliver on the floor after being denied admission.

body.html:
A case of shocking negligence has surfaced at Haridwar’s district women’s hospital, where a pregnant woman was forced to deliver on the floor after being denied admission.

Family members allege that the on-duty doctor, Saloni, told them bluntly, “No delivery will happen here,” and had the patient removed from the ward. Despite repeated pleas, hospital staff refused to help.

The disturbing incident, captured on video, is now going viral and sparking outrage over the hospital’s conduct.
